recent_excerpts: OpenAI is extending its Daybreak cyber defense program to Ukraine's government, giving civilian infrastructure defenders access to frontier AI models.
Chen Yixin, head of China's Ministry of State Security, named OpenAI's GPT-5.5-Cyber and Anthropic's Claude Mythos as signs of a 'disruptive upgrade' in offensive cyber capability.
Anthropic disrupted Midnight Blizzard (APT29) and a Chinese university group abusing Claude against 20+ government, defense and drone-supply targets, publishing IOCs for defenders.
